_doc: Maintainer-set reproduction status per leaderboard entry, keyed "<tier>/<submission>". Set an entry to {"status": "reproduced", "by": "<maintainer>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "..."} after re-running its router and reproducing its routes, then run `python -m m3d.cli leaderboard-all`. Submission PRs cannot change this file.
